create_VisionEncoderInfo: create a VisionEncoderInfo subclass to define abstract methods for image token counting and patch grid calculations
get_vision_encoder_info: get the appropriate VisionEncoderInfo instance from a HuggingFace vision language config
run_dp_sharded_vision_model: run a vision model with data parallel sharding across tensor parallel ranks
run_dp_sharded_mrope_vision_model: run a vision model with mrope and data parallel sharding for 2D or 3D rope types
resolve_visual_encoder_outputs: resolve visual encoder outputs with optional layer selection, post normalization, and feature strategy
get_load_balance_assignment: generate load balancing assignment to distribute images across GPUs by total patch size
get_llm_pos_ids_for_vision: generate LLM position IDs for vision tokens using spatial merge and grid dimensions
get_vit_attn_backend: get the attention backend for Vision Transformer based on head size and dtype
get_vision_feature_selector: get a callable feature selector function from a strategy string or custom callable
get_num_selected_vision_tokens: compute the number of selected vision tokens for a given feature selection strategy
